fact: The review states the National Broadband Policy 2018 had a five-year lifespan (2018-2023), lacked a detailed implementation plan and monitoring framework, and is followed by the Digital Transformation Roadmap 2024/25-2027/28 and the draft NDPIV.
title: Review of the implementation of Uganda's National Broadband Policy 2018 and proposed interventions
publisher: ITU and Ministry of ICT and National Guidance
